Name: Liquid Brun
Description: Liquid Brun by French Avenue is a Woody fragrance for men. Top notes are Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Bourbon Vanilla and Elemi; base notes are Praline, Ambroxan, Musk and Guaiac Wood.

Name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely
Description: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely is an oriental-woody fragrance for men. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Juniper and Violet; middle notes are Toffee, Cinnamon, Lavender and Sage; base notes are Vanilla, Amber, Tonka Bean and Suede.

Name: Le Male Elixir
Description: Le Male Elixir by Jean Paul Gaultier is an Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. Top notes are Lavender and Mint; middle notes are Vanilla and Benzoin; base notes are Honey, Tonka Bean and Tobacco.

Name: Le Male Le Parfum
Description: Le Male Le Parfum by Jean Paul Gaultier is an Oriental fragrance for men. Top note is Cardamom; middle notes are Lavender and Iris; base notes are Vanilla, Oriental notes and Woodsy Notes.

Name: Imagination
Description: Imagination by Louis Vuitton is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. Top notes are Citron, Calabrian Bergamot and Sicilian Orange; middle notes are Tunisian Neroli, Nigerian Ginger and Ceylon Cinnamon; base notes are Chinese Black Tea, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood and Olibanum.
Middle_Notes: Tunisian Neroli, Nigerian Ginger, Ceylon Cinnamon
Base_Notes: Chinese Black Tea, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood, Olibanum

Name: Y Eau de Parfum
Description: Y Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is an Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Top notes are Apple, Ginger and Bergamot; middle notes are Sage, Juniper Berries and Geranium; base notes are Amberwood, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Vetiver and Olibanum.
Base_Notes: Amberwood, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Vetiver, Olibanum

Name: Club de Nuit Intense Man
Description: Club de Nuit Intense Man by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Top notes are Lemon, Pineapple, Bergamot, Black Currant and Apple; middle notes are Birch, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambergris, Patchouli and Vanilla.
Top_Notes: Lemon, Pineapple, Bergamot, Black Currant, Apple

Name: Althaïr
Description: Althaïr by Parfums de Marly is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for men. Top notes are Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Bourbon Vanilla and Elemi; base notes are Praline, Musk, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood, Tonka and Candied Almond.
Base_Notes: Praline, Musk, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood, Tonka, Candied Almond

Name: Le Beau Le Parfum
Description: Le Beau Le Parfum by Jean Paul Gaultier is an Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Top notes are Pineapple, Iris, Ginger and Cypress; middle notes are Coconut and Woodsy Notes; base notes are Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Amber and Ambergris.

Name: Jazz Club
Description: Jazz Club by Maison Martin Margiela is a Leather fragrance for men. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Neroli and Lemon; middle notes are Rum, Java Vetiver Oil and Clary Sage; base notes are Tobacco Leaf, Vanilla Bean and Styrax.
Middle_Notes: Rum, Java Vetiver Oil, Clary Sage
